_doc: Jakub Ostrowski, the prisoner companion (Update 02 section 6.2, DECISIONS T-051; gravelight/world/jakub_companion.gd). He is not a player: no player id in GameState.player_ids / bot_ids, no co-op slot, no round scaling, no perks of his own choosing (brain perks / bonus_perk false: he never shops for one). tonics (T-127): "Talk to Jakub" can send him for one: the nearest machine within tonic_range_m that he can drink from, paid from the talker's Scrip at the normal price; same cap, lost on a down. pid: his fixed match id (never a real peer id). breakout: the round he gets out (Map 0's coal cage), the delay into that round, how long the zombie may take before the hinge gives anyway, the shovel fight. brain: BotSquad.add_brain options (docs/BOT_AI.md section 5). bleedout_seconds: his own co-op clock. wounded_hp_mult: max health on the map after the one he bled out on. call_every_s / call_unless_within_m: while he waits by the cage he calls out (positional, subtitled Polish) whenever no survivor is near. wren_scene_m: a Wren bot this close during a break plays the scene. discounts: per map, door id -> Scrip off while he is with the squad (his Kaltenbrunn shortcut). dossier_xp: his dossier page XP per event. online: true = he breaks out and joins in online co-op too (T-138: simulated on the host, a puppet on every client, CompanionNet); false keeps him in his cage online.
